title: Syllabus-style first-run collage and microcopy set
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and deliver a syllabus-style onboarding collage (a compact first-run checklist with modular cards) plus a coordinated set of empty-state illustrations and microcopy variants for the Console release. The goal is a low-friction first-run flow for new orgs that emphasizes quick wins (API key, first inference, cost dashboard) and surfaces tips without overwhelming users.
acceptance_criteria: Artboard set includes: syllabus card grid + expanded detail slide for each card + two progress states (0/3, 2/3)
Three empty-state illustrations with accessible color variants and alt text suggestions
Microcopy variants (friendly, concise, enterprise) for each checklist item and tooltip
Redlines and export spec for engineering (SVG/2x PNG, spacing tokens, CSS-ready color tokens)
Figma file linked and a reviewed PRD with final copy included
Analytics event list (eng event names) created and validated with PM/Eng so tour can track completion
tasks: Create 6 artboards: syllabus-grid, card-expanded, checklist-empty, checklist-inprogress, modal-tip, mobile-collapsed
Design 3 empty-state illustrations in two color modes (light/dark) and export SVGs
Write microcopy set: friendly / concise / enterprise for each step and tooltip
Annotate Figma frames with copy tokens, spacing, and accessible color contrasts
Handoff: export spec + screenshot placeholders + code-friendly assets in Drive folder
Follow up with Eng to confirm instrumentation keys and event names
Run accessibility contrast pass and include alt text drafts
decisions: Use syllabus card metaphor (condensed row of 3-5 cards) rather than a single linear walkthrough to allow non-linear completion
Progress bar remains optional and toggled off for enterprise orgs (privacy preference); default shows completion percentage
Empty-state illustrations use geometric motif consistent with Console visual language (no characters) to avoid localization complexity
Tone default = friendly; provide concise and enterprise variants behind settings toggle
Keyboard-first interactions: allow left/right arrows to navigate expanded cards, Escape closes modal
review_comments: 2026-03-03 - PM (Jorge Ramos): Prioritize 'Create first API key' card over sample data import for quicker time-to-first-inference.
2026-03-05 - Eng (Priya Nair): Need analytics events before we can show progress persistence across devices; blocked until instrumentation ticket is scheduled.
2026-03-09 - Design Lead (Maya Ortiz): Tighten copy on cost dashboard card to avoid fear language; suggested variant included
2026-03-11 - Accessibility (Evan Park): Light color token fails contrast at 14px; increased weight and adjusted hue in Figma
blockers: Instrumentation (ENG-5412) for onboarding events not yet scheduled
Backend API for marking checklist completion across orgs (ENG-5538) in backlog
Legal review for marketing language on trial credits mention (security/compliance review pending)
